chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Oseas gu mar gu Beeri gu tanoolh gu Osiiyas gu Joataan gu ñi'ook gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu tanoolh gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Oseas; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Oseas; mi' dhɨr tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu u'vɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' gu oidha' maa'n gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't jix bhɨɨ gu Gomer mar u'vɨ gu Diblaim jix duñia' gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jesreel; na gu' gu vaak tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr gu Jesreel bhaan gu vaak gu Jeuu gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Jesreel.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' mar u'vɨ; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Lo-ruama; na gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu vaak gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu jodai' bɨx.
Gu' gu' gu vaak gu Judaa gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch dodhia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham dodhia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx gu kuchii tu' bɨɨx gu chuukug tu' bɨɨx kavaayo tu' kavaayo.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu takarui' gu Lo-ruama jix duñia' gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Lo-ammi; na gu' gu ñi'ook cham gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ja'p oo' gu gɨ' suudai' tu' jɨ'xdha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu chuukug; gio ba' ka't pai' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham gu ja'tkam ka't tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu Israeel ka't gu jodai' maa'n jix duñia' na ba' mo'o jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha'; na gu' gu tanoolh gu Jesreel ka't jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug sɨspidhi'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu naan jix duñia'; na gu' cham gu u'vɨ tu' gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu vupui gu jodai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham ka't tu' gu jodai' cham kutun gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' na ja'p gu tanoolh jix duñia' na ja'p oidha' jix gaki mi'x dhaas na ja'p gu oidha' jix gaki gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ma'nkam; na gu' gu ma'nkam gu oi'ñga'n.
Na gu' na gu' gu naan jix duñia'; na jix mar ka't jum xibhɨ'ñ; na gu' jix aa'; jano' ba' tu jiim bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu Dan gu takarui' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ gu ux bɨ'ñdhatu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu suudai' tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx jo'ii' mia'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n cham jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' cham gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu chuukug; jano' ba' tu jiim gu jodai' maa'n gu chio'ñ; na gu' tutkɨ gu chuukug jano' ba' jano'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' tu' jix duñia' tiriik suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' gu jodai' jix toja jodai jix uam jodai bɨɨx jix duu gu Baal.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' gu jodai' jix bhɨɨ tiriik gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ gu ux ka't jix maa na ba' gu chuukug cham kutun.
Jano' ba' jano' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu vupui gu oi'ñga'n soo'mchulhdhak jix duñia' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu tasi' gu chuukug tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' jix maa gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu duukam jugi gu vaakax yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu Baales jix duñia' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu' gu jodai' oidha' jix gaki tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' dɨr gu suudai' gu Akôr gu ux ki'ñgob nɨɨra; gio ba' jix duñia' na ja'p gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu tanoolh jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios mɨmɨim gu Marido gu chuukug cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n mɨmɨim gu maa'nkar.
Na gu' na gu' gu jodai' gu chin gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Baales cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu maa'nkar mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu vaakax yooxi' bɨɨx gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx gu ko'oi gu oidha'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ u'u gat gu kuchii gu chuukug gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt koox gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' gu chuukug na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' tu' gu takarui' gu chuukug bɨx bhai' ñi'ook na jir bhai' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' gu chuukug tu' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' tu ñi'ook tiriik suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' gu Jesreel.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch xoi'kam; gio ba' gu suudai' gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam gu chuukug tu'; jano' ba' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug.

Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' xoi'kam gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook duiñchu' gu ux gu jodai' na ja'p xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' jugi jano' ba' na ba' tu' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' jix toja jodai gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' dhi' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mui'x gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook tu' jix bhɨɨ gu chio'ñ; jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' tu' gu suudai' tu'.
Na gu' na gu' mui'x gu tanoolh no'm gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham gu gɨ'kora' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu maa'nkar cham dhi' cham gu suudai' cham gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios joi'gɨ'nda' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.

Na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug bɨɨx jix koi gu oidha'; na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu'r tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' machia' gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug kooda' jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' gu ux jix duñia' gu oidha' jix duñia' bɨx jix koi bɨɨx gu vaakax yooxi' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu suudai' gu vatop gu gɨ' suudai' gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ cham gu vaak na jix bhai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ na gu' gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu takarui' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu jodai' gu tanoolh gu chuukug gio bɨndak jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu naan gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' gu ja'tkam ka't gu takarui' na gu' jix duñia' matda'; na gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n matda' tu' mi'x juu'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gio tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' gu duukam jix duñia' bhaan tu'; gio ba' gu jodai' na jix uam nɨidhat gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' kua'da' uañi'ñ gu ja'tkam tu' na cham jir bhai' gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' ka't gu ja'tkam na ja'p jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu bhóogɨt namkidha' jurtu'nka' buimɨi.
Jano' ba' jugi gu' cham jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu' cham jix duñia'; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' duñiixim suudai' u'va gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix duu tu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' bɨtaa'n gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' bhaan ɨɨbhidham gu kakkavɨk gu vaak na jix bhai' jix duñia' bhaan gu ja'tkam bɨtaa'n gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix bhai' ɨkgiga'n; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jix duñia' gu jodai'.

Na pai' dhuuk cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt tu' bhaan gu jodai' na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug; na gu' gu jodai' bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'vɨ maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu ja'tkam cham jix duñia' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tu' gu chuukug tu' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook gu Judaa; gio ba' cham kapbhai' gu Gilgal tu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Bet-aben; mi' dhɨr tu' gu chuukug jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' na ja'p ali' vaakax jix kup jix ai'chdhix gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' jano' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu chuukug gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim jix maa duiñxim; gio ba' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr chiñia' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu jɨvɨl gu oi'ñga'n makgɨrxi'ñdha' ka't jum xibhɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu chuukug gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' jix duñia' gu Mispa jix vɨgɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu Tabor.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu suudai' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka'm jix dhaam suudai'; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' jix duñia' bɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' kakasnira' gu Epraim gu Israeel cham gu jodai'; na gu' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Epraim jix duñia' tu' gu takarui' gu Israeel.
Na gu' cham jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ duñiixim tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu Israeel gu Epraim jix duñia' uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gio gu Judaa bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx kakneer bɨɨx gu jodai' jiim gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix ai'chdhix.
Na gu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' na gu' gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jano' jix duñia' gu takarui' bɨɨx dɨppɨr.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu Ramaa; gio ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu Bet-aben; mi' dhɨr bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim ka't gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh sɨlhka'n; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu oi'ñga'n jix maati' tu'r.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu Judaa jix bɨɨx duu na ja'p bhaan gu vupui; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan na ja'p gu suudai' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gu Epraim gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x ñi'ook na jir bhai' na gu' gu oi'ñga'n jiim gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' na ja'p gu duukam gu Epraim na ja'p gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Epraim ko'kdai' gu Judaa tu jiim; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jano' ba' gu Epraim gu Assur gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak; gu' cham gu kutun jix duñia' tu' jix duñia' tu jiim.
Na gu' na gu' tu' jix duñia' na ja'p maavɨt gu Epraim na ja'p gu chuukug maavɨt gu vaak gu Judaa; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook tu jiim; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ cham gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' tu jiim gu jodai' pai' bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' uañi'ñ gu suudai' gu vupui; gio ba' gu chuukug jix duñia' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios; na jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr naaka'n jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu oidha' mi' dhɨr gook gu tanoolh; gio ba' vaik gu tanoolh oirɨda' duaka' vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu jodai' jix maati' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' na ja'p gu maa'nkar gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook ɨlhdham no'ch na ja'p dhuuk na ja'p dhuuk gu tanoolh gu jodai' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tu' gu Epraim gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tu' gu ñi'ook gu Judaa jix duñia' na ja'p toov gu xibh na ja'p gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jupaabkamu'n.
Jano' ba' gu ux dhi' kuiñcha gu chuukug bɨɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chin gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai' ka't na ja'p gu tasi' gu chuukug.
Na gu' na gu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook cham gu maa'nkar; gio ba' machia' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Gu' gu' gu Adam bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan; gio ba' jix duñia' bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' na ja'p ɨ'xkum gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun gu chio'ñ gu kutun jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu Israeel buupui gu ux; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Epraim jix duñia' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gio gu Judaa jix dhaas tu' gu vaas dhaibu tu' gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' kua' tu' gu jodai' gu Israeel jix ñi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Epraim tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Samaria; na gu' jix duñia' iatda'; mi' dhɨr jupaabkamu'n ɨxkum gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mai'.
Jano' ba' cham tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ no'ñ chɨ'ñchoka' bɨx tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' jano' gu ñi'ook buimɨi; mi' dhɨr vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx tu' na cham jir bhai' gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' bɨɨx tu jiim.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tai gu ux gu takarui' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mi' dhɨr gu kutun jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh chulhiiñdha' gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' jix duu gu takarui' bɨɨx gu jodai' suudai' u'va; gio ba' jix duñia' gu novɨ bɨɨx gu chuukug.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ nɨidhim gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; gio ba' bɨx gu tukaa' gu jodai' gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu xibh gu tai na ja'p mɨmɨim gu tai.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu jodai' na ja'p gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' ia'rɨ bɨx gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim bhiibgak bɨɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Epraim ka't gu chuukug cham gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' koi'mɨk gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt cham gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai' gu ux cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu Israeel jix duñia' bhaan gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx dhi'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Epraim na ja'p gioda' gu takarui' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tɨɨt gu Ejipto gu takarui' gu Asirio.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't gu suudai' bhaan jix vɨgɨ gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug na ja'p gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu jodai' jurtu'nka' tu' naak gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook na gu' jix duñia' tu'; na gu' chajaañ bhaan na gu' bhaan tu' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu ñi'ook bhaan tu' tu jiim.
Na pai' dhuuk cham tu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' bhaan Cham na ba' tiriik gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu chuukug jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan tu' jix duñia' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu' cham gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu na ja'p gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr ia'rɨ chiñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux nɨɨn; jano' ba' gu ux ka't gu duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu chin kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk; na gu' ɨlhdham na ja'p gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na gu' bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix duñia' bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug tu' gu jodai' gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' gu Israeel jix duñia' xoi'kam; gio ba' bhaamki'ñdha' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ chiñia' gu' tu' cham gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr jix toja jodai jix uam jodai jix duu duiñxim na ba' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu tuur gu ñi'ook gu Samaria tu' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu tai gu duukam bhaan bɨɨx ka'm cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' gu Israeel gu takarui'; na cham gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ux bapaalh ka't gu suudai' tuur gu Samaria.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu jɨvɨl gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia'; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu ja'tkam tu' gu i'bhɨ jix duñia' gu tasi'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu jodai' gu Israeel; gio ba' jootom ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp na ja'p gu ux cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu suudai'.
Na gu' na gu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Assur buur gɨ' kavɨk na ba' gu duukam; gio ba' gu Epraim bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu suudai' chɨbɨɨp jano' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' chiñia'.
Na gu' na gu' jix mui' gu Epraim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ua'ñ gu suudai' ñi'ook na tu a'ga jix bɨɨx duu gu chuukug gu ux tu'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' makgɨrxi'ñdha' juana' gu maa'nkar gu chuukug koi'mɨk; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jano' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' uañi'ñ; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Israeel gu ja'tkam vaak na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix mui' jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk; gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tai jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' cham tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu ux bɨx gu chuukug tiriik.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chuukug cham gu suudai'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Epraim gu Ejipto gu Asiria pai' jugi gu kutun gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.

Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix bhɨɨ gu jodai' makgɨrxi'ñdha'; gio ba' na ja'p gu takarui' ka't; mi' dhɨr bɨx jugi ka't jix duñia'; jano' ba' ka't gu takarui' na ba'; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' na gu' gu suudai' jix bɨɨx duu kuiñcha chajaañ; gio ba' gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook gu Mempis jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ux gu maa'nkar jix bhai'x jix toja jodai gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' jix koi.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu tanoolh gu maa'nkar tɨɨtɨs gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix maati' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ kuiñcha gu oi'ñga'n tu' na cham jir bhai' jix gɨ' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Epraim na ba' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix dhaam suudai' jix duñia' na ja'p gu tanoolh gu chuukug; gio ba' jano' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu suudai' oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p gu jodai' iigɨx bɨɨpɨ' tu' tattat; mi' dhɨr baap gu Baal-peor gu ñi'ook na ba' xi'ɨraam jix duu gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p mii' dhɨr jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim gu u'uvhig gu ñi'ook gɇ'kamtu'nda' dɨr gu jodai' gu suudai' dɨr vook dɨr gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu jodai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ na gu' gu ñi'ook gio na pai' dhuuk dɨlhkob.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim bhaan gu jodai' nɨidhim gu Tiro gu oi'ñga'n pai' jix bhai'x; gu' gu Epraim jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug; gio ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tasi'.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook ka't gu Gilgal; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu maa'nkar buimɨi mi'x juu'ñ gu vaak; jano' ba' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' bɨx chiñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim ka't gu jodai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu i'bhɨ; gio ba' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' kooda' jix bhai'x vook.
Na gu' gu takarui' jix duñia' na gu' cham gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu Israeel jix bhai'x oidha' u'va gu ñi'ook gu i'bhɨ na ba'; gio ba' jurtu'nka' jix mui' gu i'bhɨ jix mui' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jurtu'nka' joi'gɨ'nda' gu oidha' jix duñia' dhi'.
Jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jano' ka't bakia' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' dhi'.
Na gu' na gu' gu chuukug jano'; na gu' cham tañia' gu gɨ'kora' na gu' cham gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' gu ux no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk aa' jix duñia' gu chuukug ñi'ook na jix bhaan; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu suudai' na ja'p gu ux gu takarui' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Bet-aben ka't gu ñi'ook jix koi gu Samaria; na gu' gu ja'tkam jix duu kuiñcha tuur jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix suudai' duu gu ux gɇ'kamtu'nda' ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' ka't baabuk gu Asiria gu o'o gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak; gio ba' gu Epraim ka't jum xibhɨ'ñ gu Israeel ka't gu takarui' gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu Samaria ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu vupui gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Abeen ka't gu suudai' uañi'ñ gu Israeel; gio ba' gu takarui' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu kakkavɨk; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu tanoolh gu chuukug uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr cham jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' na ja'p gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bhaan na pai' dhuuk ka't gu ñi'ook gook gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu Epraim gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dha' jix duñia'; gu' tu' gu suudai' bhaan gu takarui' gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu Epraim; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Judaa jix duñia' gu Jakob.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai' jix duñia' na ba' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; gio ba' gu tas na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu ux jix duñia' tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' jugi gu i'bhɨ gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu ja'tkam jix búup gu jodai' na jix uam bɨx gu bhóogɨt ka't gu suudai' na ja'p jix duñia' gu Salmaan gu Bet-arbel gu tanoolh gu chuukug; gio ba' gu naan ka't gu chuukug bhaan gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Bet-el gu ux tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' gu xibh ka't bɨx gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Israeel ka't gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai' gu Ejipto jup tɨɨt gu mar.
Jano' ba' na ja'p tɨɨt jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu Baales gu vaak na jix bhai' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tɨɨt gu Epraim jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ; gio ba' cham jix maati' tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix bhɨɨ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook xoi'kam; gio ba' jix duñia' na ba' na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tasi' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu takarui' bhaan jugi.
Na gu' cham jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Ejipto va'k gu Assur ka't gu gɨ'kora' na gu' cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu kuchii bhaan jɨ'dɨlh gu takarui' taañpu'; gio ba' gu takarui' kuiñcha gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x uañi'ñ bhaan tu'; gio ba' gu ux mɨmɨim gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x gu suudai' gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook no'ñ mi'x dhaas gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kapbhai' tu' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu chuukug na ja'p gu Adma tu' gu takarui' na ja'p gu Seboim gu i'ii'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu bhóogɨt i'iich gu ñi'ook cham gu jodai' na ba' cham tu' duu gu Epraim; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' cham gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; jano' ba' cham ba'k kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' na ja'p maavɨt; mi' dhɨr maavɨt gu ñi'ook tɨɨda' gu ma'nkam gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n tas gei'ñ.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu u'uvhig gu jodai' jix bhai'x gu Ejipto gu oidha' gu Asiria na ja'p gioda'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu u'uvhig gu jodai' jix bhai'x gu Ejipto gu oidha' gu Asiria na ja'p gioda'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Epraim bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel bɨɨx iatda'; gu' gu Judaa gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx jɨɨgi'ñdham.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu jɨvɨl gu takarui' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ñi'ook chajaañ gu suudai' jix bhai'x; na gu' jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook juraa'n gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Judaa na ba' jix duñia' gu Jakob jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix duñia' jurtu'nka' buimɨi.
Jano' ba' vook jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook xibhɨk bɨɨx gu kavɨk jix duñia' nobii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' nobii'ñ jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook bɨɨx no'ch.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix nukadham xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios jup daam bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug juraa'n gu novɨ gu oi'ñga'n ɨɨxi'ñdha' dha' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gaagam namkɨm na ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr soo'mchulhdhak gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook tu' uañi'ñ bɨx tulhiiña'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt jix koi vaak zel na ja'p gu tanoolh gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan gu ux gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' gu vaakax; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ja'p gɨ' kavɨk gu takarui' yooxi'.
Gu' gu' gu Jakob jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Aram jix duñia' gu Israeel gu ux gu u'vɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ ka't bipia'dam.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu ux jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu Ejipto gu ux jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't nukadham; gio ba' jix bhai'x tu' gu Epraim gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu suudai' jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan jix duñia' gu jodai'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Epraim ua'rgidhimɨk ka't choo'n; gio ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu Israeel; gu' jix duñia' gu Baal jix koi.

Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ jix toja jodai jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu takarui' duiñxim bɨx gu ñi'ook gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu takarui' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu xibh na ja'p gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'; gio ba' na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt ka't na ja'p kuubh gu jodai' gu chuukug.
Gu' gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' cham gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios mai' tu' gu Salbador gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' oidha' jix gaki gu oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu ux dhi' kuiñcha gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu'.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' jix duñia' na ba' na ja'p maavɨt; gio ba' na ja'p gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu chuukug tu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt na ja'p maavɨt; gio ba' gu vaakax yooxi' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu' tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' duukat gu gɨ'kora' na ba' tu' nukadham bɨɨx bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu bhóogɨt tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' chiñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' i'iich gu bhóogɨt daak.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Epraim; gio ba' uañi'ñ nukadham.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt aajim; gio ba' gu mar gu bhóogɨt cham gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ tukga'n gu ñi'ook koi'm; gio ba' gu ñi'ook koi'm tu' jix duñia' koi'm; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' chajaañ gu ñi'ook tukga'n; jano' ba' tɨtdaidha' ka't gu jodai' na jix uam gu vupui.

Jano' ba' gu ux jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam ɨlhdham gu chuukug gu jɨvɨl gu Jawatan Dios jix tɨ'ɨ baasɨ'n oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix duñia' chumñigam bɨx a'bhar gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gu Samaria ka't gu takarui' na gu' jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr a'aalh ka't gu ñi'ook ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu ux uañi'ñ gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨɨx gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ja'xñi; gio ba' gu chuukug bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ xoi'kam gu oi'ñga'n ali' vaakax gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu Assur; gio ba' cham jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan jix duñia' tu' cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu noobh; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam jix duñia' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim aagak; na gu' i'iich jix ai'chdhix.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Israeel na ja'p gu suudai'; gio ba' gu suudai' na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu jodai' ka't gɇ'kamtu'nda' na ja'p gu suudai' na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu suudai' ɨkgiga'n; gio ba' ka't gu takarui' na ja'p tiriik gu suudai' na ja'p gu tasi'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na ja'p suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim gu chuukug; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n tu' bɨɨx duiñxim tu' tu jiim gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' na ja'p ka't gu vaas; jano' ba' tu' ka't gaagam gu i'bhɨ.
Na gu' chɨkka jix maat na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' dhi' gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu oi'ñga'n na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' jir bhai' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam gu ux; gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug.
